name: screen-cast
description: Cast local videos (with embedded subtitle tracks) from your PC to a Chromecast-built-in / Google TV, from a Vue3 web app.

scripts.dev: cross-env CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true concurrently -k -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.postinstall: echo 'Run npm run dev to start the server + client in development mode. See README.md.'
